current_prompt.body:
SIMULATE the given access sequence of item IDs on a cache of capacity 5 using three eviction policies: LRU, LFU, and ARC.
FOR EACH policy COUNT cache hits and misses.
COMPUTE the hit rate for each policy.
DISPLAY the cache state after each access for each policy.
COMPARE the policies on this workload and EXPLAIN which policy achieves the highest hit rate and WHY.
INCLUDE the operative task entities LRU, LFU, ARC, and access sequence verbatim in the result.
